claims.claim: **In ALS, motor neurons die progressively** in the brainstem, spinal cord and motor cortex, causing worsening weakness, stiffness and wasting. Median survival is about 3 years from onset, and death is usually from respiratory failure.
claims.locator: European Academy of Neurology with ERN EURO-NMD (Van Damme et al.), European Journal of Neurology 31(6):e16264, doi 10.1111/ene.16264, 'European Academy of Neurology (EAN) guideline on the management of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in collaboration with European Reference Network for Neuromuscular Diseases (ERN EURO-NMD)', published 12 March 2024, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11235832/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Cognition and behaviour matter:** up to 50% have frontal or temporal extra-motor involvement, and about 10% meet criteria for frontotemporal dementia (FTD) at diagnosis. With FTD, the neurologist should assess capacity to decide and consent before treatment decisions.
claims.locator: European Academy of Neurology with ERN EURO-NMD (Van Damme et al.), European Journal of Neurology 31(6):e16264, doi 10.1111/ene.16264, 'European Academy of Neurology (EAN) guideline on the management of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in collaboration with European Reference Network for Neuromuscular Diseases (ERN EURO-NMD)', published 12 March 2024, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11235832/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **A gene mutation is found in about 20%.** Rapid gene testing for everyone with ALS is increasingly favoured, because treatments now target specific genetic subtypes.
claims.locator: European Academy of Neurology with ERN EURO-NMD (Van Damme et al.), European Journal of Neurology 31(6):e16264, doi 10.1111/ene.16264, 'European Academy of Neurology (EAN) guideline on the management of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in collaboration with European Reference Network for Neuromuscular Diseases (ERN EURO-NMD)', published 12 March 2024, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11235832/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Offer riluzole to everyone with ALS at diagnosis, for life** (strong). The dose is 50 mg twice daily. If side effects occur, consider a lower dose and reassess; stop if they persist (weak).
claims.locator: European Academy of Neurology with ERN EURO-NMD (Van Damme et al.), European Journal of Neurology 31(6):e16264, doi 10.1111/ene.16264, 'European Academy of Neurology (EAN) guideline on the management of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in collaboration with European Reference Network for Neuromuscular Diseases (ERN EURO-NMD)', published 12 March 2024, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11235832/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Edaravone, intravenous or oral, is not recommended outside a clinical trial** (interim recommendation, to be reviewed after the European phase III oral trial).
claims.locator: European Academy of Neurology with ERN EURO-NMD (Van Damme et al.), European Journal of Neurology 31(6):e16264, doi 10.1111/ene.16264, 'European Academy of Neurology (EAN) guideline on the management of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in collaboration with European Reference Network for Neuromuscular Diseases (ERN EURO-NMD)', published 12 March 2024, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11235832/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Progressive ALS from a pathogenic SOD1 mutation: offer tofersen first line** (strong). Warn about possible serious adverse events and the burden of intrathecal dosing; weigh benefit and harm carefully when progression is slow.
claims.locator: European Academy of Neurology with ERN EURO-NMD (Van Damme et al.), European Journal of Neurology 31(6):e16264, doi 10.1111/ene.16264, 'European Academy of Neurology (EAN) guideline on the management of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in collaboration with European Reference Network for Neuromuscular Diseases (ERN EURO-NMD)', published 12 March 2024, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11235832/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Not recommended outside trials:** cell-based therapies and AMX0035, until positive phase III data are available.
claims.locator: European Academy of Neurology with ERN EURO-NMD (Van Damme et al.), European Journal of Neurology 31(6):e16264, doi 10.1111/ene.16264, 'European Academy of Neurology (EAN) guideline on the management of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in collaboration with European Reference Network for Neuromuscular Diseases (ERN EURO-NMD)', published 12 March 2024, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11235832/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Care should come from a coordinated specialist ALS multidisciplinary team (MDT)**, in clinic or community, with planned appointments and home or remote visits for people who cannot attend. Reassess usually every 3–6 months, depending on how fast the disease progresses, and track function with the ALSFRS-R.
claims.locator: European Academy of Neurology with ERN EURO-NMD (Van Damme et al.), European Journal of Neurology 31(6):e16264, doi 10.1111/ene.16264, 'European Academy of Neurology (EAN) guideline on the management of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in collaboration with European Reference Network for Neuromuscular Diseases (ERN EURO-NMD)', published 12 March 2024, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11235832/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Communication:** have a speech and language therapist assess without delay, supply augmentative and alternative communication (AAC) equipment promptly, and refer to a specialised AAC hub for complex needs such as voice banking or eye-gaze access.
claims.locator: European Academy of Neurology with ERN EURO-NMD (Van Damme et al.), European Journal of Neurology 31(6):e16264, doi 10.1111/ene.16264, 'European Academy of Neurology (EAN) guideline on the management of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in collaboration with European Reference Network for Neuromuscular Diseases (ERN EURO-NMD)', published 12 March 2024, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11235832/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Look for why weight or intake is falling** (swallowing, breathing, depression, appetite, wasting, arm weakness) and involve a dietitian, speech therapist or occupational therapist.
claims.locator: European Academy of Neurology with ERN EURO-NMD (Van Damme et al.), European Journal of Neurology 31(6):e16264, doi 10.1111/ene.16264, 'European Academy of Neurology (EAN) guideline on the management of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in collaboration with European Reference Network for Neuromuscular Diseases (ERN EURO-NMD)', published 12 March 2024, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11235832/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Raise gastrostomy early and revisit it as ALS progresses**, explaining the extra risks of placing it late. If breathing is failing, start non-invasive ventilation (NIV) first and insert the gastrostomy with NIV in place. Once referred, it should happen without delay; a nasogastric tube can bridge the wait.
claims.locator: European Academy of Neurology with ERN EURO-NMD (Van Damme et al.), European Journal of Neurology 31(6):e16264, doi 10.1111/ene.16264, 'European Academy of Neurology (EAN) guideline on the management of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in collaboration with European Reference Network for Neuromuscular Diseases (ERN EURO-NMD)', published 12 March 2024, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11235832/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Offer NIV to every patient with symptoms, signs or tests pointing to respiratory insufficiency** (strong), whatever their bulbar function.
claims.locator: European Academy of Neurology with ERN EURO-NMD (Van Damme et al.), European Journal of Neurology 31(6):e16264, doi 10.1111/ene.16264, 'European Academy of Neurology (EAN) guideline on the management of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in collaboration with European Reference Network for Neuromuscular Diseases (ERN EURO-NMD)', published 12 March 2024, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11235832/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Weak cough:** start with unassisted breath stacking or manual assisted cough; move to assisted breath stacking (for example a lung volume recruitment bag) and then a mechanical cough assist device if needed.
claims.locator: European Academy of Neurology with ERN EURO-NMD (Van Damme et al.), European Journal of Neurology 31(6):e16264, doi 10.1111/ene.16264, 'European Academy of Neurology (EAN) guideline on the management of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in collaboration with European Reference Network for Neuromuscular Diseases (ERN EURO-NMD)', published 12 March 2024, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11235832/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Plan invasive ventilation discussions in advance** as part of advance care planning, to avoid emergency ventilation. Diaphragmatic pacing should not be used.
claims.locator: European Academy of Neurology with ERN EURO-NMD (Van Damme et al.), European Journal of Neurology 31(6):e16264, doi 10.1111/ene.16264, 'European Academy of Neurology (EAN) guideline on the management of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in collaboration with European Reference Network for Neuromuscular Diseases (ERN EURO-NMD)', published 12 March 2024, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11235832/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Breathlessness when ventilation is not tolerated, fails or disease is end stage:** consider opioids, and benzodiazepines when anxiety makes breathlessness worse.
claims.locator: European Academy of Neurology with ERN EURO-NMD (Van Damme et al.), European Journal of Neurology 31(6):e16264, doi 10.1111/ene.16264, 'European Academy of Neurology (EAN) guideline on the management of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in collaboration with European Reference Network for Neuromuscular Diseases (ERN EURO-NMD)', published 12 March 2024, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11235832/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Cramps:** consider sodium-channel blockers (ranolazine, quinine sulfate, mexiletine, carbamazepine), gabapentin, pregabalin or baclofen. Start quinine low (100 to 200 mg per day) and check for cardiac side effects before and after prescribing. With coexisting spasticity, try baclofen first.
claims.locator: European Academy of Neurology with ERN EURO-NMD (Van Damme et al.), European Journal of Neurology 31(6):e16264, doi 10.1111/ene.16264, 'European Academy of Neurology (EAN) guideline on the management of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in collaboration with European Reference Network for Neuromuscular Diseases (ERN EURO-NMD)', published 12 March 2024, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11235832/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Spasticity:** physical therapy, then consider cannabinoids, baclofen, tizanidine or gabapentin; for focal spasticity not helped by these, consider botulinum toxin.
claims.locator: European Academy of Neurology with ERN EURO-NMD (Van Damme et al.), European Journal of Neurology 31(6):e16264, doi 10.1111/ene.16264, 'European Academy of Neurology (EAN) guideline on the management of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in collaboration with European Reference Network for Neuromuscular Diseases (ERN EURO-NMD)', published 12 March 2024, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11235832/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Drooling (sialorrhoea):** anticholinergics first line (such as amitriptyline, atropine, glycopyrrolate); consider dextromethorphan/quinidine with emotional lability, botulinum toxin from a specialist centre if drugs fail, then radiotherapy. Surgery is not suggested.
claims.locator: European Academy of Neurology with ERN EURO-NMD (Van Damme et al.), European Journal of Neurology 31(6):e16264, doi 10.1111/ene.16264, 'European Academy of Neurology (EAN) guideline on the management of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in collaboration with European Reference Network for Neuromuscular Diseases (ERN EURO-NMD)', published 12 March 2024, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11235832/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Emotional lability:** consider an SSRI, a tricyclic or dextromethorphan/quinidine, after distinguishing it from depression and FTD.
claims.locator: European Academy of Neurology with ERN EURO-NMD (Van Damme et al.), European Journal of Neurology 31(6):e16264, doi 10.1111/ene.16264, 'European Academy of Neurology (EAN) guideline on the management of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in collaboration with European Reference Network for Neuromuscular Diseases (ERN EURO-NMD)', published 12 March 2024, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11235832/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Deep vein thrombosis:** explain the higher risk from immobility and that evidence on anticoagulant prevention is insufficient; advise passive physiotherapy, leg elevation and compression stockings.
claims.locator: European Academy of Neurology with ERN EURO-NMD (Van Damme et al.), European Journal of Neurology 31(6):e16264, doi 10.1111/ene.16264, 'European Academy of Neurology (EAN) guideline on the management of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in collaboration with European Reference Network for Neuromuscular Diseases (ERN EURO-NMD)', published 12 March 2024, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11235832/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Offer end-of-life discussions at trigger points:** at diagnosis, when breathing changes significantly, and when gastrostomy or NIV is needed. Start earlier if communication or cognition is expected to decline.
claims.locator: European Academy of Neurology with ERN EURO-NMD (Van Damme et al.), European Journal of Neurology 31(6):e16264, doi 10.1111/ene.16264, 'European Academy of Neurology (EAN) guideline on the management of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in collaboration with European Reference Network for Neuromuscular Diseases (ERN EURO-NMD)', published 12 March 2024, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11235832/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Near the end of life, make sure these are in place promptly:** a way to communicate, specialist palliative care, equipment, and anticipatory medicines (opioids and benzodiazepines for breathlessness and anxiety, antimuscarinics for saliva and secretions).
claims.locator: European Academy of Neurology with ERN EURO-NMD (Van Damme et al.), European Journal of Neurology 31(6):e16264, doi 10.1111/ene.16264, 'European Academy of Neurology (EAN) guideline on the management of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in collaboration with European Reference Network for Neuromuscular Diseases (ERN EURO-NMD)', published 12 March 2024, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11235832/, retrieved 2026-09-23
